articles.summary: NEW YORK , Sept. 17, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- GD Culture Group Limited (“GDC” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: GDC), today issued an updated news release regarding the shareholder value created by its recently announced acquisition of Pallas Capital Holding Ltd. (“Pallas Capital”).
articles.title: GD Culture Highlights Shareholder Value of Pallas Capital Acquisition: 7,500 Bitcoin Equals Approximately $22.37 of BTC Per Share
